Justin Carmical (April 11, 1971 – January 23, 2014), known online as JewWario, was an American YouTuber, games writer, and internet personality. He was known for making videos centered around Japanese video games. He created his channel in 2006 and was active until his death in 2014.
Career
Carmical was known for his video series, You Can Play This, which first stated out the website, That Guy With The Glasses, which was created by Doug Walker.
Death
The day of his death, Carmical had filmed a collaborative music video with Youtuber Jonathan Mann. He committed suicide, with a self inflicted gunshot wound, on January 23, 2014. It occurred after he was accused with allegations to grooming, assaulting producers of Channel Awesome, and sexual misconduct.
Legacy
A tribute film named Farewell, FamiKamen Rider was released the year after he passed away. The film has since been denounced by the creators of said film.
